https://mastodon.social/@harrk@gamenook..name: Harry
https://mastodon.social/@harrk@gamenook..text: No Man's Sky is a game I really want to like but it doesn't matter how many updates it gets, it still feels shallow. What I enjoy in space games is trading and working my way up. In NMS, while trading exists... the motivation just isn't there. Even after a few planets the game is like BAM! Here's a free freighter! Guess I'm projecting my ideal space game on it, and I should just accept it's not for me. I do enjoy seeing what each update brings at least. #nomanssky #videogames

https://mastodon.social/@sieffreplays/11.text: So far, Persona 3 Reload feels more like it's just copying the original beat for beat rather than tweaking and improving things here and there. They could have added more worthwhile night events, dialog choices that actually did something, or some bonus holiday event scenes. #persona #jrpg #videogames #gaming
